Let the domain of the function $\mathrm{f}(\mathrm{x})=\log _{3} \log _{5} \log _{7} \left(9 \mathrm{x}-\mathrm{x}^{2}-13\right)$ be the interval (m, n). Let the hyperbola $\frac{\mathrm{x}^{2}}{\mathrm{a}^{2}}-\frac{\mathrm{y}^{2}}{\mathrm{~b}^{2}}=1$ have eccentricity $\frac{\mathrm{n}}{3}$ and the length of the latus rectum $\frac{8 \mathrm{~m}}{3}$. Then $\mathrm{b}^{2}-\mathrm{a}^{2}$ is equal to :
(1) 5
(2) 11
(3) 9
(4)

steps:
$\log _{5}\left(\log _{7}\left(9 \mathrm{x}-\mathrm{x}^{2}-13\right)\right)>0$
$$\begin{aligned}
\Rightarrow \quad & 9 x-x^{2}-13>7 \\
& x^{2}-9 x+20<0 \Rightarrow 4<x<5 \\
& m=4, n=5
\end{aligned}$$
$$\begin{array}{l}
\Rightarrow \quad e=\sqrt{1+\frac{b^{2}}{a^{2}}}=\frac{5}{3} \Rightarrow \frac{b^{2}}{a^{2}}=\frac{25}{9}-1=\frac{16}{9} \\
\frac{b}{a}=\frac{4}{3} \\
\Rightarrow \quad \frac{2 b^{2}}{a}=\frac{8 m}{3} \Rightarrow \frac{2 b^{2}}{a}=\frac{32}{3} \\
\Rightarrow \quad 2 b^{2}=\frac{32}{3} \times \frac{3 b}{4} \Rightarrow b=4, a=3 \\
b^{2}-a^{2}=16-9=7
\end{array}$$
